zh.title: 肯亞發生EC130直升機墜毀事故致七人死亡
zh.summary: 肯亞桑布魯郡發生直升機墜機事故，導致包含五名美國人在內共七人死亡。
body: 2026年8月19日，一架歐洲直升機公司（Eurocopter）EC130 B4型直升機在肯亞北部桑布魯郡（Samburu County）墜毀，機上7人全部遇難。該架註冊號為5Y-GYM的直升機當時載有6名乘客和1名飛行員，於當地時間上午約9時13分發生墜機事故。美國國務院已證實，罹難者中包含5名美國公民。
這架直升機由Lady Lori Helicopters負責營運，當時正在執行載運奢華遊獵公司&Beyond旅客的包機任務。關於該航班的具體飛行航線，相關單位的說法不一：肯亞民航局（KCAA）表示，該直升機當時正從Loisaba保護區飛往Ewaso Nyiro地區；而Lady Lori Helicopters則指出，該直升機是在執行從Suyian保護區飛往Ololokwe的包機任務。

在罹難的6名乘客中，包括厄瓜多國家情報中心（National Intelligence Center）主任米歇爾·森西-孔圖吉（Michele Sensi-Contugi），以及他的妻子、擁有美國與厄瓜多雙重國籍的史蒂芬妮·霍利漢·瓦斯科內斯（Stephany Hollihan Vasconez）。另一名乘客則被證實為總部位於佛羅里達州的Telemundo電視台高階主管荷西·阿爾貝托·蘇亞雷斯（José Alberto Suárez）。美國駐肯亞大使館已與當地政府取得聯繫，並正在提供領事協助。
這起墜機事故發生在鄰近奧洛洛奎山（Mount Ololokwe）的基里什（Kirish）附近偏遠地區。由於當地地形偏遠且多山，使肯亞紅十字會及其他多個機構的現場救援與搜救行動變得相當困難。目前肯亞航空事故調查部（Air Accident Investigation Department）已對這起事故展開調查，以釐清墜機原因。
EC130 B4是一款由歐洲直升機公司（現為空中巴士直升機公司，Airbus Helicopters）開發的七座單引擎直升機。該機型因其寬敞的客艙、低外部噪音和無遮擋的視野，被廣泛應用於觀光與包機飛行。墜機地點奧洛洛奎山（又名Ol Donyo Sabache）是桑布魯地區的知名地標，也是健行和野生動物旅遊的熱門目的地。

en.title: Seven killed in EC130 safari helicopter crash in Kenya
en.summary: A Lady Lori Helicopters flight crashed in Samburu County, Kenya, killing all seven occupants.
body: On August 19, 2026, a Eurocopter EC130 B4 helicopter crashed in Samburu County, Kenya, resulting in the deaths of all seven people on board. The helicopter, registered as 5Y-GYM, was carrying six passengers and one pilot when the accident occurred at approximately 09:13 local time. According to the United States State Department, five of the victims were US citizens.

The helicopter was operated by Lady Lori Helicopters on a charter flight carrying guests of the luxury safari company &Beyond. Operational statements regarding the flight route differed; the Kenya Civil Aviation Authority (KCAA) reported the flight was routing from Loisaba Conservancy to the Ewaso Nyiro area, while Lady Lori Helicopters stated the helicopter was flying from Suyian Conservancy to Ololokwe.

Among the deceased passengers were Michele Sensi-Contugi, the director of Ecuador's National Intelligence Center, and his wife, Stephany Hollihan Vasconez, who was a dual US-Ecuadorian citizen. Another passenger was identified as José Alberto Suárez, a Florida-based senior Telemundo executive. The US Embassy has established contact with local authorities and is providing consular assistance.

The accident took place near Kirish, close to Mount Ololokwe in northern Kenya. The remote and mountainous nature of the terrain complicated the recovery operations of the Kenya Red Cross and other responding agencies. Kenya's Air Accident Investigation Department is leading the official investigation into the cause of the crash.

The EC130 B4 is a seven-seat, single-engine helicopter developed by Eurocopter, which is now part of Airbus Helicopters. This aircraft type is widely utilized for sightseeing and charter flights because of its large cabin, low external noise, and unobstructed views. The crash site near Mount Ololokwe, also known as Ol Donyo Sabache, is situated within Kenya's northern safari circuit.

zh.title: 美空軍完成C2E便攜指揮控制原型評估
zh.summary: 美空軍完成C2E便攜指揮控制原型評估；將支援ACE作戰
body: 美國空軍宣布已完成「Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) Portable Command and Control Enclave」（C2E）原型評估，這是一款用於指揮半自動CCA的便攜式地面站。
該次評估由俄亥爾州國民警衛隊178號戰鬥機聯隊主持，位於Springfield Air National Guard Base。
空軍指出，來自示範活動所收集的資料將用於指導C2E選案的後續階段，第二階段原型將挑戰廠商展示其C2E雲端能力。
空軍表示，C2E旨在支援其「Agile Combat Employment (ACE)」作戰理念，強調這些便攜式系統可在全球快速部署，包括在惡劣環境中運作。

en.title: US Air Force completes C2E portable command centre prototype trials
en.summary: US Air Force completes C2E portable command centre prototype trials; to support ACE operations
body: The United States Air Force has concluded prototype evaluations for the Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) Portable Command and Control Enclave (C2E), a portable ground station for commanding and controlling semi-autonomous CCAs.
The demonstration was hosted by the Ohio Air National Guard's 178th Wing at Springfield Air National Guard Base.

The Air Force said insights and data gathered from these demonstrations will inform the next stages of the C2E selection process, with the second prototype phase expected to challenge vendors to refine and demonstrate their C2E cloud capabilities.

The C2Es are described as highly portable command-and-control systems that can be rapidly deployed and operated anywhere in the world, including austere environments, and are intended to support the Air Force's Agile Combat Employment (ACE) operations.

zh.title: 索馬里航空 Somali Airlines 九月復飛
zh.summary: 索馬里航空計劃九月恢復營運；民航局稱準備就緒；已獲兩架A320
body: 索馬里航空 Somali Airlines 計劃於 2026 年 9 月恢復營運，結束長達 35 年的停飛。
索馬里民航局局長 Ahmed Moalin 表示，復飛準備工作已完成，航班預計下月啟動。
索馬里政府於 2025 年 7 月採購兩架空中巴士 A320（ICAO 機型代碼 A320）作為復飛機隊。
索馬里航空成立於 1964 年，1991 年因內戰導致中央政府倒台而停飛。
政府曾多次宣佈復飛計劃，但 2023 年與 2025 年底的目標均未能如期實現。
目前摩加迪休亞登國際機場（MGQ）由衣索比亞航空、卡達航空及土耳其航空等國際航司提供服務。

en.title: Somalia targets September return for Somali Airlines after 35-year hiatus
en.summary: Somali Airlines plans September restart; CAA says preparations complete; two A320s acquired
body: Somalia's flag carrier Somali Airlines plans to resume operations in September 2026, ending a 35-year hiatus; Somali Civil Aviation Authority director Ahmed Moalin said on Saturday that preparations for the relaunch have been completed and flights are expected to begin next month.

The Somali government acquired two Airbus A320s in July 2025 as part of efforts to relaunch the national airline; Somali Airlines was established in 1964, four years after independence, and operated until the collapse of the central government in 1991.
The government has previously announced plans to revive Somali Airlines but missed earlier targets for restarting operations, including a 2023 target and a 2025 end-of-year target.
Currently, Mogadishu’s Aden Adde International Airport (MGQ) is served by international airlines such as Ethiopian Airlines, Qatar Airways, and Turkish Airlines.
